build.label: main 9643900 plus LOTUS-INTERACTIVE-02; Release; 2026-11-08; dynamic clocks; validation layers disabled

clocks: dynamic; nvidia-smi sampled once a second: P0 at 1695-1920 MHz, with 15-21% of the 128-frame runs' samples in P5 or P3 at 375-1200 MHz

metric_notes.outputs: One render per frame: raw is its fresh batch, temporal the bounded temporal mean (the history), filtered the a-trous composite of that mean. The filter never feeds back into history. progressive is a separate progressive render restarted at the sequence's sample index on every change: the Reference preset's image. A moving workload therefore repeats its random numbers every frame (DES-Q7), which lowers its frame-delta MSE.
metric_notes.mse: RGB squared error against the pose's reference, every pixel, averaged over sequences and then frames. Finite reference noise (reference_noise_mse) is included, not subtracted.
metric_notes.frame_delta_mse: Temporal residual: each frame's error minus the previous frame's at the same pixel, squared. It measures flicker and lag; the cut frame has none.
metric_notes.history_buckets: Squared error by the pixel's history length in batches, frames after the cut pooled: the response after disocclusion or rejection.
metric_notes.last_frame_ensemble: The last frame across independent sequences. Mean MSE is the squared error of their mean; noise is its expected sampling part; excess estimates the squared bias, and can be negative.
metric_notes.history_resets_after_cut: Frames after each sequence's cut rendered without history, by reset reason, summed over sequences: today's invalidation, recorded rather than required.
metric_notes.lag_region: Where the fixture's lag shows: albedo is every pixel whose primary surface has the fixture's lagging material, per frame; swept is every pixel whose reference luminance ranges over more than a tenth of its brightest pose and six times the mean reference noise; none has no region. mean_pixels averages its size over frames.
metric_notes.lag_region_mse: RGB squared error against the pose's reference in the lag region, frames after the cut pooled; by frame, null where the region is empty.
metric_notes.deterministic: The first sequence rendered again from a new cut reproduced every raw, temporal and filtered value bit for bit; progressive is not repeated.
metric_notes.gpu_ms_median: Per frame, with whatever validation layers are active; filter covers every iteration and the composite.
